who: GPT-6 Astra Pro, upstream repair lane
what: The third-party gate stopped reading the historical base at proc-macro-test before reporting current count violations. The base's proc-macro-srv manifest lists that path only in dev-dependencies, but its Cargo.lock entry includes the edge without its dependency kind.
cost: Native gate run 45315686765 reported a historical graph error instead of the current third-party count findings.
cause: Graph::reach followed every lock edge for vendored third-party packages, although workspace_from correctly omitted nonmember dev manifests. Package ownership was incorrectly used to choose whether dependency kinds could be read from a local manifest.
class: a dependency graph loses edge kinds when package provenance chooses the traversal
prevention: Every path package uses its manifest's normal and build edges; vendored packages still count as third-party. The selftest plants the historical dev edge, moves the same edge to normal and build with a transitive registry package, refuses a missing reachable manifest, and keeps current and base ceiling checks active.
workaround: None; neither historical census errors nor dependency counts are skipped.
fix: Source and selftest prepared; exact-tree native execution remains required.
